titleTr: İş yeri kuralları: have to, must, don't have to

grammar.topic: have to / must / don't have to
explainTr: Zorunlu şeyler için 'have to' ya da 'must' kullanılır: You have to wear a badge. (Kimliği takmak zorundasın.) He / she / it ile 'has to' gelir: She has to sign in. İkisinden sonra da fiil yalın kalır.
Soru ve olumsuz için 'do/does' kullanılır: Do I have to sign in? He doesn't have to work on Friday. (Gerek yok, serbest.)
Dikkat: 'don't have to' (gerek yok) ile 'mustn't' (yasak) aynı değildir. You mustn't use your phone. = Kullanman yasak.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'gerekmiyor' ve 'yasak' farklı kelimelerdir (zorunda değilsin / yasak). İngilizcede de ayrıdır: don't have to = gerek yok, mustn't = yasak. Türkçe 'zorundayım' tek ek ile gelir; İngilizcede 'have to' ayrı yazılır.

reading.title: Rules at the school
reading.text:
On her first day, Hafsa reads the rules for school workers. Mr. Brown explains them in the front office.

"First, you have to wear your badge all day," he says. "Second, you have to sign in when you arrive. Visitors have to sign in, too, and they must wear a visitor badge." Hafsa writes this on her notebook.

"What about a uniform?" Hafsa asks. "You don't have to wear a uniform," Mr. Brown says. "But you must look neat. And you mustn't use your phone in front of students. That is against the policy."

"Do I have to work every day?" "No, you don't. You only have to work Monday to Thursday. You have a thirty-minute break for lunch. And remember: the last person has to lock the office door." Hafsa smiles. "I understand. It is easy to follow these rules."
